video_title: Knicks-Spurs Finals! And Offseason Questions for the Thunder and Cavaliers | Third Apron Podcast

quotes.speaker: Sam Quinn
quotes.summary_phrase: The Thunder-Spurs playoff series was highly anticipated and lived up to the hype
quotes.excerpt: This Thunder-Spurs series was one of the more hyped playoff series I remember in a while.

text_blocks.speaker: Sam Quinn
text_blocks.text: This Thunder-Spurs series was one of the more hyped playoff series I remember in a while. Game 1 100% lived up to it. But then the next several games were not super close. It felt like in all of 3, 4, 5, and 6, one team pretty definitively had control.

text_blocks.speaker: Yossi Gozlan
text_blocks.text: It was incredible, everything about it from start to finish. The comebacks in between, but just the Spurs, they are just in control once you got to the second half of the third quarter.

quotes.speaker: Sam Quinn
quotes.summary_phrase: The Thunder and Spurs are both better than the Knicks when fully healthy
quotes.excerpt: I do think fully healthy the Thunder and the Spurs are both probably better than the Knicks.

text_blocks.speaker: Sam Quinn
text_blocks.text: I do think fully healthy the Thunder and the Spurs are both probably better than the Knicks. Much as I thought in 2016 that the Warriors and the Thunder were both at full strength better than the Cavs, but those two teams just beat the ever-loving shit out of each other so badly that when the Warriors got to the Finals, they were firmly in control in those first two games.

text_blocks.speaker: Yossi Gozlan
text_blocks.text: I agree, I think they were the best team and maybe even a tier of their own. That team was so good, it just people forget about it because it was so short.

quotes.speaker: Sam Quinn
quotes.text: I know the Knicks have beaten the Spurs twice in the regular season. The number I would key in on, the Knicks are plus-16 in Victor Wembanyama's minutes in those three games. They are not just killing Luke Kornet like the Thunder were earlier in this series. They were genuinely going toe-to-toe with the Spurs at full strength. Victor Wembanyama, this is the defensive test of his life. I think he is one of the best players in the NBA specifically at guarding Wembanyama.
quotes.summary_phrase: The Knicks have performed well against the Spurs in regular season matchups
quotes.excerpt: The Knicks are plus-16 in Victor Wembanyama's minutes in those three games.

quotes.speaker: Sam Quinn
quotes.text: The Thunder are set to make 58.5 million dollars next year. The Thunder do not have a player on their roster who will make that much. Therefore, in order to match salary, they would have to aggregate salaries, which means they would have to get below the second apron because aggregating salaries hard-caps you at the second apron. Why is this relevant? Because in order to match salary on and get below the second apron, the Thunder would have to shed 98 million dollars in the trade or through other mechanisms. It is an absurd amount of money. I do not think we have ever seen a team have to move that much money to duck a hard cap.
quotes.summary_phrase: The Thunder face significant financial hurdles to acquire Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: I do not think we have ever seen a team have to move that much money to duck a hard cap.

quotes.speaker: Sam Quinn
quotes.text: The Cavaliers are not good enough to win a championship with this iteration of the roster. They have to make some sort of substantial change. They either have to get meaningfully better this year or they have to take a step back, presumably by trading Donovan Mitchell and saying we are going to focus on reorienting around Evan Mobley. I think it has to be one of those two things. Mobley does not have to go in your all-in vision, but you either have to take a step forward or you have to get a bunch of assets to take a step back. Just running back this version of the team is to me a wasted year.
quotes.summary_phrase: The Cavaliers must make substantial roster changes to contend for a championship
quotes.excerpt: Just running back this version of the team is to me a wasted year.

quotes.speaker: Sam Quinn
quotes.text: I am willing to go to LeBron James and say I am going to do the following things. Number one, if you sign, I will fire Kenny Atkinson and hire Jason Kidd as the head coach. If that is a condition of getting LeBron at the minimum, LeBron plus Kidd is better than Kenny plus no LeBron. I think Kenny Atkinson is a better coach than LeBron or a better coach than Jason Kidd, but I am willing to make that concession if LeBron is willing to come for the minimum if he wants that. Number two, I am willing to trade any and all draft picks that I have to improve the roster this season if LeBron is willing to come for the minimum.
quotes.summary_phrase: The Cavaliers should consider coaching and roster changes to sign LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: LeBron plus Kidd is better than Kenny plus no LeBron.
